integrity: The claim is supported by an analytic negative-covariance argument, renewal occupation law and Pareto-tail limit; Python diagnostics are not used as an infinite-system proof. Scientific priority is subject to independent scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: Infinite-lattice within-cycle current only; exponents strictly between 3/2 and 2. Does not count reset relocations or establish the law for finite periodic lattices or at endpoint exponents. Decimal calibration is not interval certified.
title: Zero-mean but directionally unequal Pareto currents in an alternating-reset exclusion process
